blurb: Guests join fully guided fishing trips on jet boats to fish for Alaska salmon and trout on the Knik, Little Susitna, Deshka, and Talkeetna Rivers. Trips include all fishing gear, bait, and rain gear. The guides use specialized rods, reels, and lures tailored for salmon and trout fishing.

quotes.text: I wanted to thank you guys for all you did to help me catch that King in June. That was my first king Salmon and it was totally do to the expertise, professionalism, skill and patience of Jerry. Thank you for the kindness and the opportunity to go back out with Jerry the next morning after my first day I failed to produce a fish. That kindness was greatly appreciated. It was the Alaska experience I had hoped for. Jerry, Thanks again for two great days of fishing and I look forward to lots more in the future. Ray, Terri thank you both again for two days that will live in my memory forever.

Fisherman’s Choice is a class-A operation. Good boats. Good gear. Fantastic customer service and communication. They were as determined to get us fish as we were. Our guide Jeremy and his sidekick Storm were top-notch and loads of fun. We laughed a lot and learned about “sky raisins.” They helped make some wonderful king salmon memories with family out there on the gorgeous Alaskan water. We are happy customers. We will be back again. Dawn K Anchorage, AK

Fishing with Jeremy was awesome. He’s clearly a seasoned fisherman and our whole family enjoyed being on the boat with him. He was great with our kids. The river was beautiful- we did the 5:00am trip. Jeremy’s fishing skills helped our son catch a huge king salmon. Highlight of our trip to Alaska! Jen B UTAH

Ray showed us a great time on our fishing trip on 7/2/19. He was persistent after a few spots initially didn’t produce any Kings for us. We soon all limited out with some great looking fish. Ray filleted and bagged the fish for us. We would definitely use his services again and again. Thanks Tony

Ray was patient with both me and my girlfriend. And when we caught a fish, he took the time to break it down for us right on the side of the river. Would definitely recommend and we will cherish our experience. Thank you Ray! Nade Maria
A great experience; the entire team was terrific getting us booked. Doug was a fantastic guide and did an awesome job. We’re already planning our next trip. Thank you! Joey
